text:
Elaine: Heads up — I'm doing a focused pass on docs style + terminology specifically for SDK snippets and example pages. Noticed a mix of snake_case and camelCase params, inconsistent microcopy for 'route' vs 'endpoint', and a few broken links. Planning a short checklist + PR template to coordinate. Thoughts? cc @Devin @Maria

Devin: +1. Quick proposal: 1) canonicalize SDK param naming to camelCase, 2) keep CLI examples using kebab-case, 3) canonical glossary entries for 'model variant' and 'deployment tier'. Also add lint rules to CI to catch naming mismatches.

Maria: I dug up 4 broken links on the examples page — will paste them below. For existing tutorial snippets, we should avoid breaking users; need a migration plan (deprecation alias or docs notes).

Sam: I agree with not breaking code samples. Suggest batching small snippet fixes into a single "snippet-fixes" PR per language. For changes that alter public API names, we need a migration guide + codemod. Also +1 on adding a docs CI linter.

Elaine: Draft checklist I'm thinking of:
- run snippet linter across repo (naming + formatting)
- run link checker and fix or redirect broken URLs
- update glossary with canonical terms and synonyms
- add deprecation notes where we change param names
- include before/after examples in PRs for any breaking edits
Who wants to take the codemod work?

Ashley: I can prototype a codemod for Python and JS. FYI: examples currently using `input_text` should move to `inputText`. We'll keep an alias for one release and log a deprecation WARNING.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs core merge window opens next Tuesday 09:00 PT. Please tag PRs with `docs/core`.

Devin: :thumbsup: I'll consolidate the small fixes (JS+Python snippets + link updates that are non-breaking) into an umbrella PR. Maria — can you paste the broken links here?

Maria: Here are the ones I found:
- https://redwood.ai/docs/examples/old-embed -> 404
- https://redwood.ai/sdk/python/v1/params -> redirects, needs pinned example
- https://redwood.ai/guides/legacy-auth -> outdated (refers to old token flow)
- https://redwood.ai/examples/chat-legacy -> 302 to a page missing snippets
I'll open the link-fix PRs today and tag them for review. ETA 2026-03-24.

Elaine: For glossary canonicalization I propose the following core list (short):
- model
- model variant
- route (primary term) — alias: endpoint
- deployment tier
- token unit
Add synonyms/notes so search still finds old terms. Any objections?

Sam: Looks good. One small note: customers often search for "endpoint" so please add an alias line in the glossary entries.

Ashley: Codemod plan (brief):
- JS: run AST replace for `input_text` -> `inputText`, add wrapper that maps old key to new with console.warn
- Python: same but keep kwarg alias and emit warnings in logs
I'll add unit tests and a small harness to run against the examples directory. Target prototype 2026-03-27.

Elaine: Action items (summary):
- Devin: umbrella PR for snippet + non-breaking link fixes (due 2026-03-24)
- Maria: broken link PRs + list in the thread (due 2026-03-24)
- Ashley: codemod prototype for Python/JS (due 2026-03-27)
- Sam: update glossary page with canonical terms and synonyms (due 2026-03-25)
- Elaine: draft and post PR template for docs migrations in #docs by EOD

Devin: Sounds good, I'll start the umbrella branch now and ping for reviews.

Maria: I'll open the first link PR and mark it `docs/core`. Thanks all.

Elaine: Thanks team — I'll follow up with the PR template and a tiny snippet linter config (rules: enforce camelCase for SDK params, allow snake_case in CLI contexts). :sparkles:
